releaseNotes: [Batch rename] Supports batch renaming of smart file names after analysis is completed
[Batch Tags] Supports adding and deleting tags to files in batches after analysis is completed
[Batch cleaning] Scan to remove duplicates, identify naming errors, extension errors, and optimize and correct
[Analysis Rule Inheritance] Directory profiling analysis strategies, intelligent file name rules, and additional attributes support inheritance
[New models] Qwen3.8, Ornith-1.5 and other latest community high-scoring models, and some outdated models have been removed
[Built-in model] Switch to high-speed model LFM2.5-1.2B, complete an analysis in 2 seconds
[DSpark Acceleration] The built-in model supports DSpark model acceleration on computers that only support CPU inference.
[Directory structure generation] Supports one-click copying of prompt words to external AI such as Doubao to obtain high-quality file directory structure
[Support location] Check place name information based on file metadata coordinates and add tags
[Simplified configuration] File information extraction simplifies the configuration file and obtains file information more intelligently and efficiently.
[UI Performance] Remove all UI animations that occupy the GPU
[Stable architecture] Remove possible incompatible optimizations introduced in V3.4 for various hardware environments

latestNews.text: V3.5 Added batch renaming, batch labeling, and batch cleaning
Nanbeige 4.2 — The Ultimate Value Choice: Super intelligence with just 3GB VRAM, please upgrade to V3.2+
New cloud service provider Agnes AI added, with a permanently free API that is accessible from mainland China networks
